digest.component_or_area: plan-review threshold calibration and impact model validation
propositions: The plan-v2 severity-first MAX impact model with 0.85 hard-override floor shipped 2026-07-08 has never undergone segmented threshold replay, and block-rate rose from ~25% pre-calibration-2 to 52-67% post-calibration-2, requiring evidence-based adjudication of blocking thresholds against plan-v2 findings.

The plan-v2 segmented replay corpus contains 1016 sidecars across 264 tickets and 23877 findings, with 1052 sidecars skipped (217 different-version, 835 untagged), and all non-DET blocking-tier criteria must be adjudicated using a pre-registered decision rule based on validity, rev_rr, indeterminacy, and p90 priority.

No criterion in the plan-v2 segment reaches BLOCK-ELIGIBLE status (the rule requires rev_rr≥0.6, validity≥0.55, indet≤0.15; highest rev_rr is G5 at 0.565), and p90 priority saturates at exactly 0.85 for nearly every criterion, indicating the hard-override floor dominates the priority distribution.

T5e criterion (currently blocking at 0.60) is classified FP-PRONE (validity 0.391 < 0.45 threshold; 59% drop rate) and must be demoted to advisory per decision rule (b), with all other blocking criteria kept at current thresholds pending floor-split analysis on dependent story.

Floor-attribution analysis must quantify blocks where the hard-override floor was the deciding factor (floorless impact below threshold but floored impact met it), with specific classification of ac_unverifiable findings into missing_oracle, underspecified_oracle, or ambiguous categories, recorded on dependent story 7d91.

The adjudication and script enhancements must be durably recorded in Gerrit with criteria_routing.json edits (T5e demotion only), extended calibrate_plan_review_thresholds.py with skipped-remainder counter, and updated plan-review-threshold-calibration.md 'Calibration 3' section documenting the replay table, per-criterion decisions, and calibration-4 caution regarding rev_rr depression in BLOCK-loop regimes.
